body.name: explicit four-event calibration
body.construction: For every \(\beta\in(0,1)\), set \(b_n(\beta)=\min\{n,\lceil8\log(2/\beta)\rceil\}\). Write \(n=m b_n(\beta)+r_\beta\), where \(0\le r_\beta<b_n(\beta)\), and partition \(\{1,\ldots,n\}\) into consecutive blocks with the first \(r_\beta\) of size \(m+1\) and the remaining blocks of size \(m\); all blocks are nonempty. Let \(\operatorname{MOM}_{\beta}\) be the \(\lceil b_n(\beta)/2\rceil\)-th order statistic of their block averages, set \(V_{\mathrm{env}}=2^{16}(1+C_{\mathrm{env}})^8\), and set \(\rho_n(\beta)=4V_{\mathrm{env}}\sqrt{b_n(\beta)/n}\). Allocate error \(\alpha/4\) to each of \(E_D,E_K,E_A,E_S\); inside \(E_K\), allocate \(\alpha/16\) to each of the four raw residual moments.
